name: trigger_body_changed
comment: ADR-0042: a different body (after whitespace normalization) is a change; so is a different timing, event set, update-of list, or relation. The generated step guards the previous declaration (MIG-012) and recreates from the new one.

current.sql: insert into widget_log (widget_id) select o.id from {old: id} o;

snapshot.sql: insert into widget_log (widget_id) select n.id from {new: id} n;
